messengers.intro: The Messengers don't claim mastery over the Signal. They receive it, preserve it, and carry it forward without weakening its meaning — witnesses first, performers second.

about.philosophy: The project moves between the sacred and the street — Metatron's Cube next to a blueprint, an X-ray beside a manuscript. Ancient knowledge, modern static. The spine sits at the center of all of it: thirty-three vertebrae, seven nodes, one signal moving through the whole structure.
about.transmissionsExplainer: Numbered pieces called Transmissions carry the Signal forward — visual, lyrical, sometimes both. Each one is filed once and never reused.
